additional_concerns: The substantive-performance candidate has no executable meaning. The excerpts support continuing responsibility and proper ownership records, but do not supply a complete supervision or performance standard, incident tolerance, assessment period, or actual compliance facts.

The encoded candidate answers only duty activation under the expressly assumed independent-footnote reading. Its constant true result within scope must not be reported as performance, compliance, SFC satisfaction, or resolution of the competing harmonised reading.

Footnote 5's reference to paragraphs 10–13 does not supply their complete contents. The separately quoted paragraph 13 concerning intermediaries cannot automatically substitute for paragraph 13 of the Product Provider circular.

Paragraph 15 separately conditions third-party audit or verification on an SFC request. Paragraph 16 separately conditions obtaining a legal opinion on a request; neither establishes an unconditional procurement requirement.

The register-maintenance provisions and intermediary outsourcing provision support distinctions between operational actors and retained responsibility. They do not establish that allocating authority alone fulfils the Product Provider's substantive requirement.
The supplied structural validation and retrieval results establish neither legal applicability nor source sufficiency. No supplied external dependency qualifies as AVAILABLE.
